recent_en: Titijaya Land Berhad proposes to divest its Penang Logistics Hub 5 asset to Pelaburan Hartanah Berhad for approximately RM300 million cash and has been buying back shares on the open market.
notable_en: Proposed divestment of Penang Logistics Hub 5 to Pelaburan Hartanah Berhad for approximately RM300 million cash.
Released audited financial statements for the financial year ended 30 June 2026.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Dato' P'ng Soo Hong disposed of 62,000 ordinary shares on 4 September 2026 for RM13,020 on the open market.
